name: claw-00-selftest
vram_ceiling_note: 512 MiB: context+JIT overhead dominates (~192-384 MiB on WSL2); job buffers are job-capped to fit. Enforced: job is rejected with an honest error receipt above this.

seed_policy.determinism: bitwise-stable per (device, driver): fixed-order f32 FMA map y=fma(y,a,b), y0=hash(gid,seed); output_sha256 is the witness. Cross-device drift is expected and is signal, not failure.

input_schema.job_id: string, optional; default generated from claw name + time
input_schema.memcpy_bytes: int bytes per d2d buffer, default 67108864, range [1048576, 536870912]
input_schema.flop_chunk_elems: int f32 elements per chunk, default 4194304, range [1024, 67108864]
input_schema.flop_inner_iters: int FMAs per element per pass, default 4096, range [1, 1000000]

output_schema.stream: stdout, exactly one JSON line (the receipt); also emitted on failure — no receipt = never happened

exit_codes.2: preempted — receipt with progress + partial results (status=preempted)

telemetry.line_schema: {ts, phase, progress_sofar, items_per_sec, vram_mb, gpu_temp_c, util_pct}
telemetry.degraded_marker: receipt.telemetry=degraded when VRAM sample unavailable (WSL2 NVML is quirky); temp/util nulls alone do not degrade

throttle.semantics: read at chunk boundaries; 1.0=full speed, 0<p<1 stretches boundary by (1-p)*2s, 0=pause until raised or canceled

cancel.response: at next chunk boundary: receipt status=preempted with progress + partials, exit 2

host_assumptions.deps: none hard-required: CUDA driver API + NVML via ctypes; numpy only for the CPU-fallback lane

notes: First cudaclaw. Validates recruit->run->receipt->preempt loop before any real kernel risks it. One process per job; subprocess in list form only, never shell=True; O(chunk) memory.
